Palestinian Astronomical Society
                     (PAS)

PAS' Mailing List

The Palestinian Astronomy mailing List is used to discuss different astronomical issues between the members of the society as well as to arrange meetings , make schedules ,...etc. that is everything related to the society . Every member need to subscribe to the list by clicking here , and then each time he needs to send an email to the list he just send to palestine-astronomy@onelist.com which is the address of our mailing list .
